title: For events held in 2020 that were attended by members majoring in Education
question: For events held in 2020 that were attended by members majoring in Education within the College of Education & Human Services, calculate the percentage of the total budget allocated to 'Food' across all such events.

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b."XCL_004" = 'Food' THEN b."XCL_007" ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(b."XCL_007")
FROM event AS e
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON e."XCL_010" = a."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN member AS m ON a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN major AS mj ON m."XCL_042" = mj."XCL_030"
INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e."XCL_010" = b."XCL_009"
WHERE SUBSTRING(e."XCL_012", 1, 4) = '2020'
  AND mj."XCL_031" = 'Education'
  AND mj."XCL_033" = 'College of Education & Human Services'

react.raw_react_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b."XCL_004" = 'Food' THEN b."XCL_007" ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(b."XCL_007")
FROM event AS e
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON e."XCL_010" = a."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN member AS m ON a."XCL_002" = m."XCL_034"
INNER JOIN major AS mj ON m."XCL_042" = mj."XCL_030"
INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e."XCL_010" = b."XCL_009"
WHERE SUBSTRING(e."XCL_012", 1, 4) = '2020'
  AND mj."XCL_031" = 'Education'
  AND mj."XCL_033" = 'College of Education & Human Services'
